tasks.short: Identify and document a program problem on screen or in content.

steps.what: Identify the program problem on the online screen.
Document the output and the screen content.
Analyze function, output and content from that note.

loop.input: the evidence note: steps, output and content the tester captured
loop.output: a short analysis that quotes only that note
loop.check: every quoted line must appear in the note; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a missing step is left blank
loop.why_not_simpler: naming the cause is not a quote

steps.what: Confirm which program function actually failed.
Document the confirmed problem for the developer.

tasks.design: The tester still finds the problem on the running program. The evidence note on {DOCS} holds steps, output and content. A draft analysis is kept only when every quoted line is in that note. The tester confirms the function that failed. The defect on {PROJECT} is filed from that confirmation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The problem lived in a chat, and the developer could not replay it.
tasks.enabler_now: Steps, output and a screen note are fields. A quote can be checked against them.
tasks.still_hard: A failure that appears once, or only on one person's data, is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which function the user actually touched, and which output is the wrong one.
tasks.altitude: Writing the evidence takes less time. Finding the problem and confirming the function stay. The tester does not hand the cause to the draft.

reach.learn: Which function failed, and what the screen showed

evidence.claim: A defect with steps and output can be replayed. A draft that only quotes those fields is not a diagnosis.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester identifies and confirms. The developer fixes. Support may report the symptom, which is a different task.
Structured input: build id, steps, expected output, actual output, content id. Producer is the tester during the run. A note with no build id is not filed.
The draft adds no cause that the note does not state.
unknowns: Are builds identified so a run can be repeated?
Where do screen notes sit today?
research_questions: How often is a filed defect missing the steps?

already_counted.description: Confirming the function is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire evidence notes whose build is gone.

approvals.approved_version: problem the tester confirmed for that build

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the failure cannot be repeated, the note stays thin and the confirmation stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document software defects in the tracker and report them.

steps.what: Check that the software defect is complete.
Document software defects in the tracking system.
Report defects to the software developers.

tasks.design: A defect is documented on {PROJECT} only after the tester checks that steps, build and expected result are present. The report to developers is a notice of that row, not a new write-up. The check stays.
tasks.previous_blocker: Defects were retyped from a note into a tracker, and the developer heard about them late.
tasks.enabler_now: The tracker fields are fixed. A notice is a link to the row.
tasks.still_hard: A defect that is still incomplete has to be sent back, and that judgement stays.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows when a report would send the developer after the wrong function.
tasks.altitude: Retyping and chasing the report shrink. Checking the defect stays. The tester does not gain a right to skip a thin report.

reach.learn: Which row is ready, and which is not

evidence.claim: A tracker row with required fields stops an empty defect. It does not find the bug.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester documents and reports. Finding the problem is the previous task. The developer fixes.
Structured input: title, build, steps, expected, actual, severity. Producer is the confirmed problem. A row missing steps is not reported.
The check is the remaining tester time. The notice is not a second description.
unknowns: Does every defect already have a build id?
research_questions: How many defects arrive without steps?

already_counted.description: Checking the defect is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Close reports whose defect was withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: tracker row the tester marked complete

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the problem is only verbal, the tester still writes it and the report waits. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop testing programs for regression, negative cases and usability.

steps.what: Choose database, regression, negative or usability areas.
Draft software scenarios for those testing areas only.

loop.input: the areas the tester named, and requirement ids
loop.output: scenarios that cite only those areas and ids
loop.check: each scenario names an area and a requirement id; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; an area with no requirement is left empty
loop.why_not_simpler: which scenario is worth running is not a template

steps.what: Decide which scenarios enter the testing program.
Store the testing program for later runs.

tasks.design: The tester chooses the areas: database impact, regression, negative cases, error retests, usability. A draft on {DOCS} is kept only when each scenario cites an area and a requirement id. The tester decides what enters the program. {PROJECT} stores that program.
tasks.previous_blocker: Programs were a private list, rebuilt for each release, with areas easy to forget.
tasks.enabler_now: Area and requirement id are fields. A scenario can be refused when an id is missing.
tasks.still_hard: Which negative case is realistic, and which usability issue matters, stay a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which area broke last time, and which scenario would waste a cycle.

ambition.what: Refresh the program when a change lands, not only at release start.

tasks.altitude: Drafting scenarios takes less time. Choosing areas and deciding the program stay. A change can refresh the program in the same week.

reach.task: See which areas the program covers
reach.learn: Which scenarios are in for this change

evidence.claim: A scenario that must cite an area and a requirement id is a check. It does not decide the program.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester develops the program. Developers write the change. Running the program is a later task.
Structured input: area, requirement id, scenario title. Producer is the tester for the area, and the requirement record for the id. A blank id is not stored.
No scenario is added for an area the tester did not name.
unknowns: Who else must accept a usability scenario?
research_questions: Which areas are skipped when the program is rebuilt by hand?

already_counted.description: Deciding the program is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire scenarios whose requirement was withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: scenarios the tester chose for that change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If requirements have no ids, the draft is empty and the tester writes the scenarios. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design test plans, scenarios, scripts or procedures.

steps.what: Read requirements and name the scenarios.
Draft scripts and procedures for those scenarios.

loop.output: scripts and procedures that cite only those scenarios
loop.check: each script names a scenario; else discard
loop.stop: one draft; a scenario with no steps is left as a heading
loop.why_not_simpler: the design of what to keep is not a script

steps.what: Design which scripts and procedures stay.
Store the approved scripts and procedures.

tasks.design: The tester names the scenarios from the requirements. Scripts and procedures on {DOCS} are kept only when each one cites a named scenario. The tester designs what stays. {PROJECT} stores that set. A script is not saved because a draft existed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans were rewritten in a document that drifted from the requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: A script that must name a scenario is a check. The design of the set is not.
tasks.still_hard: Which procedure is worth the time, and which script would be brittle, stay a design judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The tester knows which path the release actually depends on.
tasks.altitude: The first draft takes less time. Naming scenarios and designing the set stay. Nothing is stored without that design.

reach.task: Read the stored procedures before a change

evidence.claim: A script tied to a named scenario can be checked. Designing the set cannot.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the tester designs the plan. The testing program of areas is a different task. Developers do not approve the plan unless the firm says so.
Structured input: requirement id, scenario name, steps. Producer is the tester for the scenario name. A script with no scenario is not stored.
Design time stays on the review. Upkeep is retiring scripts for withdrawn scenarios.
unknowns: Are scenarios named before scripts are written?
research_questions: How often does a stored script cite no scenario?

already_counted.description: Designing the set is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire scripts whose scenario was dropped.

approvals.approved_version: scripts and procedures the tester designed for that plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If requirements are unscanned prose, naming the scenarios stays manual and the draft waits. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Finding a problem, choosing test areas and designing the script set stay with the tester. Filing a complete defect and storing a chosen program take less retyping. A draft that invents a step is discarded.
reach: Developers receive a defect that names the build and the function.
A later run can open the stored program.
skills_to_grow: Name the scenario before a script is stored.
role.ambitious_version: A change can refresh the testing program in the same week, and a thin defect is not reported.

job.title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
